title: Virus Blaster
author: Claude
blurb: GLITCH, a virus off a bad BBS download, is eating the family 486. Shrink down, launch the BLASTER nano-fighter and blast your way up the motherboard, through memory, the sound card and the hard disk into the CPU itself.

box.tagline: Your PC has a virus. Shrink down and blast it.
box.back:
Late one night you downloaded COOLGAME.ZIP from a BBS you had never called before. It was not a cool game. It was GLITCH, a virus that eats a PC from the inside out - Mom's tax return, Dad's novel, your homework, YOUR HIGH SCORES.

Load VACCINE.EXE, shrink to the size of a byte and climb into the BLASTER, the fastest nano-fighter ever to fit through a floppy drive. Scream up the data bus of the motherboard, dodge the data streams of Memory Lane, ride the thumping speakers of the Sound Card, fight the spin of the Hard Disk platter and burn into the CPU itself. Five stages, ten scrolling runs, five towering bosses built out of dozens of monsters each - and GLITCH waiting at the core.
features: A real vertically scrolling shoot-'em-up made with Game-Maker - no programming
Auto-fire twin blasters, plus Nova Bombs that fan out five plasma bolts
Five stages inside a 486: the motherboard, memory, the sound card, the hard disk and the CPU
Five bosses, each built from dozens of monsters, plugging the only way out
Turrets that sweep and fire, virus hatches, firewalls, data streams and thumping speakers
Twelve Sound Blaster songs and digitized explosions
An animated FLI intro cartoon and a self-playing demo

reviews.quote: We did not think Game-Maker could scroll like this. Then GLITCH ate our high scores and we stopped thinking at all.
The most fun you can have with a computer virus.
